versos.texto_bv: E voltei o rosto para o Senhor Deus, para buscar oração e súplicas, com jejum, saco e cinza.
versos.traducao_literal: E dei o meu rosto ao Senhor, o Deus, para buscar oração e súplicas, em jejum e saco e cinza.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): “para buscar oração e súplicas” é sintaxe artificial em pt-BR: “buscar” não rege “oração e súplicas” como objeto idiomático (piso de naturalidade, EDITORIAL §1.1-4). A naturalização praticada pelas três referências torna o Senhor o objeto do verbo (“para buscá-lo com oração e súplicas”), o que altera o objeto sintático-semântico presente na traducao_literal — mudança de sentido, vedada ao revisor de forma. — evidência: ARA: “para o buscar com oração e súplicas”; NVIPT: “me voltei para o Senhor Deus com orações e súplicas”; NTLH: “orei com fervor ao Senhor Deus, fazendo-lhe pedidos e súplicas”. Traducao_literal BV: “para buscar oração e súplicas”.

kjv.texto: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:

vizinhos.2: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.
vizinhos.4: And I prayed unto the Lord my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;

web.texto: I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

vizinhos.2: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah the prophet, for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.
vizinhos.4: I prayed to Yahweh my God, and made confession, and said, Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,
